title: Intent timeout — deadline_at exceeded → TIMED_OUT
description: Intent with deadline_at = now + 45 seconds. The agent is registered but uses a no_op handler (never resumes). The TIMEOUT scheduled job fires when deadline_at passes, transitions the intent to TIMED_OUT, and emits the intent.timed_out webhook. The runner verifies that resume on a TIMED_OUT intent returns 4xx.

agents.description: step 1/1 — no_op: intentionally never resumes (triggers timeout)

durability._comment: deadline set to 45s by runner for fast demo
